{"metadata":{"description":"oh-my-dsh：面向 DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 的插件生态——700+ 插件，只通过扩展接缝注册，不修改 agent-loop 骨架","id":"gh:1333125623","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"oh-my-dsh","slug":"LaplaceYoung/oh-my-dsh","topics":["agent","deepseek-harness","dsh-ecosystem","dsh-plugin","oh-my-dsh"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"oh-my-dsh：面向 DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 的插件生态——700+ 插件，只通过扩展接缝注册，不修改 agent-loop 骨架"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"oh-my-dsh"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Every capability the peer harnesses ship, as DSH plugins."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A capability library for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) —
open all the way down, never touching the agent lo"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"apability library for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) —
open all the way down, never touching the agent loop."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The capability surface for the DSH agent, ported from the harnesses that got it right. Every
plugin "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"registers through a documented extension seam — never a patch to the skeleton, never a
hot-path tax."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**530** plugins · **3731** tests · **2183/2183** e2e registration checks · **6/6** live-session
chec"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ks against a real DeepSeek model."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> [!NOTE]
> oh-my-dsh is a **capability library**, not a fork. Each plugin adapts one gap from a
> p"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"eer harness (Claude Code, Oh-my-pi, kimi-code, opencode, Codex CLI, …) into a drop-in DSH
> plugin. "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"The full gap ledger lives in `GAP-LEDGER.md`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## The capabilities, _adapted_."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 01 · Deep research, wired to `ctx.web` + `ctx.llm`"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`deep-research` decomposes a compound question into sub-questions, searches and fetches sources
in p"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"arallel through DSH's portable web seam, and synthesizes a cited report. Configure a
`provider` + `m"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"odel` and synthesis runs through the LLM; leave them unset and a deterministic
template report still"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" lands — every path degrades gracefully, none require a real key to test."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 02 · Tower — multi-agent orchestration with conflict coordination"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`tower` dispatches a list of instructions to a team of worker subagents that iterate one repo
concur"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"rently. Every worker reads the shared team brief (so M1 owns the README while M2 reads it),
then a r"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"eviewer — always on the primary model — re-reads their outputs and flags conflicts.
Ported from kimi"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"-code's `/tower` (MoonshotAI/kimi-code#2633). `fleet-orchestrator`,
`microagents`, and `specialist-a"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"gents` cover the long tail of fan-out shapes."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 03 · Pre-write secret scanning as a monotonic guard"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`secret-scanner` registers a `tools.guard` that denies `write`/`edit`/`apply_patch` calls whose
argu"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ments carry API keys, tokens, or private keys — before any filesystem mutation, and with no
allow-ov"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"erride path. Conservative patterns, low false-positive. `repo-secret-audit` sweeps what's
already on"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" disk; `git-secret-gate` watches what's about to be committed."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 04 · Stream rules that catch the model mid-drift"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"`stream-rules` injects regex-matched reminders into the stream the moment the model goes
off-script "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"— oh-my-pi's time-traveling stream rules, rebuilt on DSH's event waterfall.
`semantic-compression` s"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"hrinks context while preserving meaning; `cache-aware-compaction` and
`compact-fidelity` keep the co"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"ile preserving meaning; `cache-aware-compaction` and
`compact-fidelity` keep the compression honest."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 05 · GitHub workflow over the shell seam"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`github-workflow` wraps the `gh` CLI (`issue create/list`, `pr list`) through `ctx.shell`
(`resolve "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"→ run`), with a `child_process` fallback for standalone use. Structured `--json` output
parsed on th"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"e way back. `pr-description` and `pr-review-bot` take it from triage to review."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### 06 · Lineage & kanban projections"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`branch-tree` renders fork lineage (parent→children, ancestry, fork points) and `task-board`
project"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"s a parallel-task kanban (columns, blocked reasons, dependency tree) — both cycle-safe.
Data lives i"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"n-session; persistence is a consumer step."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 07 · Sessions, _the whole lifecycle_"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Twenty-four `session-*` plugins cover the arc no single harness owns end to end: `session-snapshot`
"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"and `session-rewind` for checkpoint rollback, `session-share` for cloud links, `session-search` /
`s"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ession-retrieval` / `session-semantics` for getting old work back, `session-rbac` for who may
touch "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"what, `session-replay` and `session-export` for audit. opencode's share model, Codex's
rollout vocab"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ulary, and Claude Code's checkpoint — reconciled in one namespace."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### 08 · Approvals with a vocabulary"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Six `approval-*` plugins turn permission prompts into policy: `approval-vocabulary` remembers
once/a"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"lways/reject per tool (Codex CLI's `/approvals`), `approval-queue` and `approval-persist`
make decis"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ions durable and reviewable, `approval-diff` and `approval-binding` tie each decision to
the exact c"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"hange it approved, `approval-grace` adds expiring trust. `autonomy-tier` sets the ceiling."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### 09 · Memory that survives the session"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`memory-writeback` lands Claude Code's `CLAUDE.md` loop; `episodic-memory`, `procedural-memory`,
and"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" `graph-memory` store what happened, what works, and how things connect; `memory-consolidation`
and "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"`memory-promotion` move what repeats from raw recall into durable knowledge. Project-scoped by
defau"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"lt — what the agent learns about this repo stays with this repo."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### 10 · MCP, bridged _and governed_"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Seven `mcp-*` plugins: `mcp-bridge` speaks the protocol, `mcp-registry` catalogs servers,
`mcp-trust"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"` and `mcp-poison` decide what's allowed to answer, `mcp-capabilities` negotiates
surface, `mcp-brow"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ser` drives a browser server, `mcp-extension-ecosystem` keeps the whole thing
discoverable. The ecos"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ystem without the supply-chain blind spot."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### 11 · A browser fleet, seven plugins deep"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`browser-driver` at the wheel, then one plugin per concern: `browser-session`, `browser-a11y`,
`brow"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ser-form-fill`, `browser-network`, `browser-scraper`, `browser-visual-assert`. Not one
omni-tool — t"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"he same browser capability decomposed into seams you can mount independently."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### 12 · Red team, built in"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"`jailbreak-detector` and `injection-guard` watch the prompt stream, `sandbox-escape` and
`sandbox-in"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"tent` watch the tool surface, `adversarial-eval` and `redteam-orchestrator` run the
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"DSH is an all-plugin harness: the agent loop itself is a plugin, and new behavior lands through
docu"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"mented seams — never by editing the skeleton."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| seam | purpose |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| `ctx.tools` | model-facing tools (`register` / `guard` / `restrict`) |
| `ctx.shell` · `ctx.fs` | "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"shell + filesystem providers |
| `ctx.subagents` | child agents (`spawn` / `fork` / `acp` / `codex` "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"/ `claude-code`) |
| `ctx.workflows` | scripted multi-agent orchestration |
| `ctx.llm` · `ctx.web` "},{"id":"p36s4","text":"| model routing + search/fetch |
| `ctx.sessionPersistence` · `ctx.sessionQuery` | durable sessions "},{"id":"p36s5","text":"+ query |
| event waterfall | `agent/pre-step`, `tools/pre-execute`, `session/event`, … |"}],"truncated":true}
